框架鼓以單面鼓皮振動發聲，鼓面寬度大於淺框深度，共鳴空間較小；若框上裝金屬環或響: The frame drum sounds from the vibration of a single head, the width of the head being greater than the depth of the shallow frame, so the resonating space is small; if metal rings or jingles are fitted to the frame, striking brings a continuing metallic sound. The source records no range, no way of controlling volume and no particular description of timbre, so nothing is guessed here. Beside other membranophones of the family, its structural features are the wide, shallow round frame, the single head, and the possible addition of jingles.
框架鼓屬於最古老的樂器之一，但來源未提供確切起源年份或地點。其發展與傳播主要呈現: The frame drum is among the oldest instruments, but the source gives no exact year or place of origin. Its development and spread are seen mainly in the division of playing between cultures: the larger frame drums are mostly used by men in spiritual ritual, the medium ones mostly played by women. As for its modern spread, the international Tamburi mundi festival in Freiburg, Germany, holds masterclasses and concerts every year, showing the activity of frame-drum players.
框架鼓是鼓面寬度大於淺框深度的膜鳴樂器，H-S編號211.3，屬最古老的樂器之一: The frame drum is a membranophone whose head is wider than the shallow frame is deep, H-S number 211.3, and among the oldest instruments. It is usually a single piece of raw hide or a man-made material stretched on a round wooden frame; the frame may be rosewood, oak or ash, and plywood or man-made materials are also used; the head is fixed with nails or tuned mechanically, and metal rings or jingles may be fitted to the frame. In many cultures the larger ones are mostly played by men in religious ritual and the medium ones mostly used by women.
框架鼓的實際聆聽場合多見於儀式與節慶演出。來源指出，在許多文化中，較大的框架鼓主: The frame drum is mostly heard on ritual and festival occasions. The source notes that in many cultures the larger frame drums are mainly played by men in spiritual ritual, and the medium frame drums mainly by women. In addition, the international Tamburi mundi festival is held every year in Freiburg, Germany, with masterclasses and concerts and well-known frame-drum players on stage, which is an occasion for hearing frame-drum performance.
鼓面通常以生皮製成，也可使用人造材料；鼓面張於圓形木製框架上。框架傳統以玫瑰木、: The head is usually of raw hide, though man-made materials may be used; the head is stretched on a round wooden frame. The frame is traditionally made of woods such as rosewood, oak and ash, bent and joined, though plywood or man-made materials are also used. Metal rings or jingles may be fitted to the frame. The source does not state the materials of the other parts.
